common.appDescription: Heat-stress safety for outdoor workers in the UAE.

specimen.title: Arish Signal
specimen.lead: Gulf shade meets industrial signage. Unmistakable at arm's length, calm under pressure, field-tough.
specimen.bandNote: Hatch density encodes the level: none, sparse, medium, dense cross-hatch. Each cell also carries the level numeral, and the current hour is inverted.

shell.draftTranslationNote: This translation is a machine draft. A native speaker has not reviewed it yet.

roleChooser.title: Choose your role
roleChooser.intro: Heat-stress safety for outdoor workers. Pick the view that matches your job.
roleChooser.demoNote: This is a demo. There is no login, and all data shown is synthetic.

worker.title: Worker
worker.line: Today's heat level for your site, and your own limit.

supervisor.title: Supervisor
supervisor.line: Heat timelines for your crews. Crew totals only, never individuals.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page does not exist or has moved.

today.title: Today
today.limitation: When the app is closed you get site and crew warnings only. Your personal risk shows when you open the app or tap a warning. It is worked out on this phone and never sent to the server.

empty.title: Set up your heat profile
empty.reason: Set up once so we can work out your own heat limit. It takes about a minute.
empty.secondary: See today's site level without setup

hero.personal: Your own level, worked out on this phone.
hero.site: Site level, the same for everyone at this site.
hero.personalUnavailable: Your own level is not available right now, so the site level is shown.

consent.title: Your profile stays on this phone
consent.stored: Your type of work, the date you started working in heat, and your clothing option. They are stored only on this phone.
consent.server: Nothing from your profile. If you turn on alerts, an alert subscription for your site (and your crew, if you chose one) is sent. It is not linked to your name or profile.
consent.use: It is never used for discipline or employment decisions.
consent.revoke: You can remove your data at any time from Alerts.
consent.agree: I have read this and I agree

form.heading: Set up your heat profile
form.startDate: Date you started working in heat
form.startDateHint: Used to work out how used to the heat you are. It is not shared.

errors.futureDate: The date cannot be in the future.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.intro: Get a warning on this phone when your site or crew level changes.
alerts.limitation: When the app is closed you get site and crew warnings only. Your personal risk shows when you open the app or tap a warning. It is worked out on this phone and never sent to the server.
alerts.noSite: Choose your site first. Alerts are sent for one site.

state.subscribed: Alerts are on for this site.
state.error: We could not turn alerts on. Try again in a moment.
state.disableError: We could not turn alerts off. Try again in a moment.

unsupported.title: Alerts are not available on this phone
unsupported.body: This browser cannot receive alerts. You can still open the app to see today's levels.

insecure.title: Alerts need a secure connection
insecure.body: Open the app from its secure address (https) to turn on alerts.

denied.title: Alerts are blocked
denied.body: You blocked alerts for this app. To turn them on, open your browser settings for this site and allow notifications, then come back.

install.title: Add the app to your Home Screen first
install.body: On iPhone, alerts only work after the app is added to the Home Screen.
install.step1: Tap the Share button in Safari.
install.step3: Open the app from your Home Screen and turn on alerts.

removeData.button: Remove my data from this phone
removeData.hint: Deletes your profile and turns off alerts. You can set up again at any time.
removeData.confirmTitle: Remove your data from this phone?
removeData.done: Your data was removed from this phone.
removeData.failed: We could not finish removing your data from this phone. Alerts may still be on, or saved data may remain. Check your connection and try again.
removeData.pending: Your data was removed from this phone. We could not reach the server yet to cancel your alert subscription. It will be tried again each time you open Alerts.

push.body: Open the app to see your own level.

supervisor.title: Crews
supervisor.privacyNote: Crew totals only. This view never shows individual workers.

empty.title: No crews yet
empty.reason: Crews appear here once they are added for this site.

supervisor.suppressed: Fewer than {k} people — detail hidden to protect privacy

empty.title: HSE overview
empty.reason: The site-wide HSE view is coming in the next release. Meanwhile, you can preview the supervisor view.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.detail: We could not load this. Check your connection and try again.

stale.title: Last updated {time}
stale.detail: This may be out of date. Levels refresh when you are back online.

actions.pending: Action wording for this level is awaiting review.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: This page is not saved on this phone yet. Pages you opened before still work.
